conclusions: Compass primary ranking retrieval is unavailable for all four positive and all four none cases. The original limit outcomes remain in the denominator.

Graphify primary ranking retrieves zero of four positive and zero of four none classes at each registered cutoff 10/50/100. All eight exact classes exist in its graphs and resolve through public source-coordinate queries; they are not extraction misses.
Graphify returned 200 hub rows; 163 have unique graph label identities and matching distinct-pair degrees. The other 37 remain ambiguous, never selected by degree or external rating.

All eight Graphify unfiltered neighbor projections match stored displayed direction/label/relation triples (234 rows); this is graph consistency, not source-precision proof or identity-rich navigation.
No precision-at-k, broad god-object classification accuracy, authored explanation score, representative performance result or Compass superiority follows.

A live CloudStack sample and code inspection identify speculative repeated SQL prefix scanning before dollar-delimiter syntax rejection as a concrete follow-up. No optimization or improvement claim has been tested here.
